looks.mark themes.py css: def css(themes_settings: dict | None) -> str: out = ["/* Dionysus themes (plexcache/themes.py): the page shows the one named by <html data-theme data-mode> */"] for t in everything((themes_settings or {}).get("custom")): for mode in ("light", "dark"): props = [f"--{k}:{v}" for k, v in t[mode]["colors"].items()] props += [f"--sans:{_FONT_STACK[t['fonts']['text']]}", f"--head:{_FONT_STACK[t['fonts']['headings']]}", f"--spots-a:{t['decor']['spots'] / 100:g}", f"color-scheme:{mode}"] out.append(f':root[data-theme="{t["id"]}"][data-mode="{mode}"]{{{";".join(props)}}}') return "\n".join(out) + "\n"
